headline: New stores drive sales as comps slip and margins compress
summary_short: Net sales rose 4.7% y/y to $2.33 billion as new-store growth offset a 1.0% comparable-store sales decline, while net income fell 3.4% y/y to $129.2 million on margin compression and higher SG&A.
summary_long: Sprouts grew revenue through continued store expansion — 490 stores as of June 28, 2026 — even as comparable-store sales fell 1.0% y/y, versus +10.2% comp growth in the prior-year quarter. Gross margin slipped 10bp to 38.7% on loyalty-program costs and elevated fuel expense, partly offset by self-distribution and vendor-participation gains. SG&A rose to 29.4% of sales on new-store investment and softer comps. Net income fell 3.4% y/y to $129.2 million, though diluted EPS rose 1.5% to $1.37 on a smaller share count from an active buyback ($70.7 million repurchased this quarter under the $1 billion authorization). The company guided fiscal-2026 capex to approximately $310 million.
